questions.explain: The client runs on the flight controller, the agent on the companion/PC.

questions.q: Which message must stream before switching to Offboard?
questions.explain: Otherwise PX4 will not switch or arm in Offboard.

questions.q: Below what OffboardControlMode rate does PX4 exit Offboard?
questions.explain: That is how the documentation puts it; the code is more precise (offboardCheck.cpp): the signal is lost when the last OffboardControlMode timestamp is older than COM_OF_LOSS_T = 1 s. 2 Hz is a margin: at 2 Hz one missed message already gives a 1 s gap.

questions.q: What matters about the px4_msgs branch?
questions.explain: Otherwise the message definitions do not match.

questions.q: What are the topics from PX4 called in ROS 2?
An altitude of 3 m in TrajectorySetpoint (NED) is Z = …

questions.explain: NED: the Z axis points down.

questions.q: Which QoS does a subscriber to /fmu/out/* need?
questions.explain: A QoS mismatch means the topic stays silent.
